secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign/verify session JWT cookies (jose HS256). Required for auth to function.

secrets.name: VITE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Manus platform OAuth app ID. Required for login flow. Obtain from Manus project settings.

secrets.name: VITE_OAUTH_PORTAL_URL
secrets.description: Manus OAuth portal base URL (e.g. https://auth.manus.space). Required for login redirect.

secrets.name: OAUTH_SERVER_URL
secrets.description: Manus OAuth API server URL used for token exchange and user info. Required for login.

secrets.name: OWNER_OPEN_ID
secrets.description: Manus openId of the project owner; auto-granted admin role on login. Optional.

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_URL
secrets.description: Manus Forge API base URL for storage proxy and owner notifications. Optional.

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Manus Forge API key (Bearer token) for storage proxy and notifications. Optional.
